about_company.about_long: Coforge is a Indian IT services company that builds and runs technology for enterprise clients, positioning itself as an AI-native engineering firm. Its largest verticals are banking and financial services, travel, healthcare & hi-tech, and insurance, and the Americas contributed about 62% of revenue in Q1 FY27 (including two months of Encora). About 86% of that quarter's revenue came from AI-led engineering, data & integration and cloud services, with intelligent automation and BPM making up the rest. Revenue is earned mainly on multi-year service contracts, including large engineering programmes such as a 13-year partnership with Sabre. It has grown by acquisition as well as organically: Cigniti (quality engineering) joined in FY25, and Encora (US/LATAM engineering, estimated at about $600 million of FY26 revenue when it was signed) has been consolidated since May 2026.
about_company.about_short: IT services firm: AI-led engineering, data and cloud for banking, travel, insurance, healthcare and hi-tech

what_changed.text: From 1 May 2026 Encora added US$100.7 million to Q1 FY27 revenue of US$592.2 million. Versus Q4 FY26 (ex-Encora), Healthcare & HiTech rose from 11.5% to 17.3% of revenue, Americas from 56.7% to 61.8%, AI-led Engineering from 45.1% to 50.4%, and fixed-price work fell from 46.3% to 43.0%.

about_company.business_intro: Coforge is an Indian IT services firm that designs, builds and runs software and data platforms for large enterprises, mainly in banking, travel, insurance and healthcare. It earns revenue from multi-year engagements billed on time-and-materials (57% of Q1 FY27 revenue) or fixed price (43%), with about half of IT revenue delivered onsite. It has grown by buying firms and cross-selling into their clients: Cigniti (2024) and Encora (consolidated from May 2026).

company_timeline.detail: FY23 revenue was US$1,002 million, against US$628 million in FY21 (issuer figures adjusted for exceptional and one-time items).

company_timeline.title: Takes board control of Cigniti Technologies
company_timeline.detail: Coforge held 28% of Cigniti (a quality-engineering firm) and board control from 5 July 2024, and consolidated its results from Q2 FY25. The stake was still 27.98% on the October 2024 call.

company_timeline.title: Wins the Sabre deal, US$1.56 billion over 13 years
company_timeline.detail: Announced during Q4 FY25 (Jan-Mar 2025); management said Sabre picked Coforge as its engineering partner for a 13-year period after a shortlist of four. The deal is counted as US$1.56 billion of FY25 order intake.

sources.label: Q4 FY26 factsheet, order book table footnote

company_timeline.title: Signs an agreement to buy Encora for US$2.35 billion
company_timeline.detail: Announced on 26 December 2025: 100% of Encora at an enterprise value of US$2.35 billion, US$1.89 billion of it in Coforge shares issued to the sellers. Closing was still pending at that date.

company_timeline.title: Closes the Encora acquisition
company_timeline.detail: The transaction closed in April 2026 and Encora has been consolidated from 1 May 2026. Q1 FY27 includes two months of Encora revenue, US$100.7 million.
